# clickhouse_byoc_infrastructure_ready (Resource)

Wait until a BYOC infrastructure reaches the `infra-ready` state.

A restricted-access BYOC infrastructure (`clickhouse_byoc_infrastructure` with
`access_model = "restricted"`) is created in the `infra-awaiting-connector`
state and only becomes ready once the connector the customer installs has
enrolled and set up the platform layer. Make `clickhouse_service` resources
depend on this resource so they are created only once the infrastructure can
host them.

Creating the resource polls the infrastructure for up to 90 minutes and fails
if it becomes `infra-degraded`, `infra-terminating` or `infra-terminated`
instead. Once created, the resource keeps the recorded readiness: it is not
refreshed, and a later degradation does not plan a new wait. Destroying it
only removes it from the state.

~> **Note:** This resource is in beta. Its behavior may change in future provider versions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Wait for a restricted-access BYOC infrastructure to become ready once its
# connector is installed, then deploy services into it.
resource "clickhouse_byoc_infrastructure_ready" "restricted" {
  byoc_id    = clickhouse_byoc_infrastructure.restricted.id
  depends_on = [helm_release.connector]
}

# A service on restricted-access infrastructure runs at one fixed size: no
# profile, equal memory bounds, a fixed replica count and no idle scaling.
resource "clickhouse_service" "byoc" {
  name           = "restricted byoc service"
  password_hash  = "n4bQgYhMfWWaL+qgxVrQFaO/TxsrC4Is0V1sFbDwCgg=" # base64 encoded sha256 hash of "test"
  cloud_provider = "aws"
  region         = clickhouse_byoc_infrastructure.restricted.region_id
  byoc_id        = clickhouse_byoc_infrastructure_ready.restricted.id

  ip_access = [
    {
      source      = "0.0.0.0/0"
      description = "Anywhere"
    }
  ]

  min_replica_memory_gb = 48
  max_replica_memory_gb = 48
  num_replicas          = 3
  idle_scaling          = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `byoc_id` (String) ID of the BYOC infrastructure to wait for.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the BYOC infrastructure.
- `state` (String) State of the infrastructure when readiness was confirmed. Not refreshed afterwards; read the clickhouse_byoc_infrastructure data source for the current state.
